engine.trust.reason.neglect: Nothing landed in {region} for two terms.
engine.trust.reason.repairs_overdue: Repairs put off are still not done.
engine.rule.neglect: A region is overlooked when two terms pass with nothing landing there; a national card lands everywhere.
engine.visit.stitched: Already made safe on an earlier visit, and counted: {tips}.
engine.visit.exposure.pass: Exposure held: your tips cover about {got} in 10 of the homes below the tips, weighted by risk; this visit needed {needed} in 10.
engine.visit.exposure.fail: Exposure did not hold: your tips cover about {got} in 10 of the homes below the tips, weighted by risk; this visit needed {needed} in 10. {best} has the most homes below it.
engine.visit.fairness.pass: Fairness held: {tip} protects streets in the poorest tenth of Wales ({edition}).
engine.visit.fairness.fail: Fairness did not hold: none of your tips is above streets in the poorest tenth of Wales ({edition}). {best} is.
engine.visit.lifelines.none: Lifelines held: no tip at the top risk step stands above a school or the railway.
engine.visit.lifelines.pass: Lifelines held: you covered {covered} of the {total} top-risk tips above a school or the railway.
engine.visit.lifelines.fail: Lifelines did not hold: {missing} stands at the top risk step above a school or the railway, and you needed to cover at least {need} of the {total}.
engine.visit.aros.pass: Young people can stay: it held in {runs} runs in 10. Homes came from {homes}; work from {work}.
engine.visit.aros.fail: Young people can stay did not hold: {runs} runs in 10, against 6 needed. It needs a Homes thread and a Work thread that pay off. Homes came from {homes}; work from {work}.
engine.visit.iaith.pass: Welsh as the street language held in {runs} runs in 10. It came from {iaith}.
engine.visit.iaith.fail: Welsh as the street language did not hold: {runs} runs in 10, against 6 needed. It came from {iaith}.
engine.visit.pwysau.pass: What the valley can carry held in {runs} runs in 10.
engine.visit.pwysau.fail: What the valley can carry did not hold: {runs} runs in 10, against 6 needed. Pressure came from {pressure}; the river needed {river}.
engine.letter.named.tip_safe: {tip} is grass now. Somebody chose it, and I know it was you.
engine.letter.named.visit: They still talk about the year you came to {place} and asked where to start.
engine.letter.named.pledge_kept: You made {count} promises out loud and kept {kept}. People here count.
engine.letter.named.pledge_broken: You promised us {thing} in {year}. We remember the year better than the promise.
engine.letter.named.debt: The loans from {year} are still on the books: {count} of them.
engine.letter.named.repairs: The repairs put off in {year} were never done. We have been doing them since.
engine.letter.named.neglect: {thing} waited the whole time for something of its own.
engine.letter.named.card: What I can still point to is {thing}, from {year}.
engine.letter.named.arrival: {thing} arrived in {year}, after you had gone. It counts.
engine.letter.named.lost_term: The term you lost the seat, {year}, is still the first thing people mention.
